annotations.title: New restaurants and shops coming to Gilbert

description: Use for "what is opening in Gilbert", "new restaurants in Gilbert AZ", "is <name> coming to Gilbert", "what is opening near SanTan Village / Agritopia / Downtown". Returns places from the Town of Gilbert liquor-license list and county permits with what the record says (filed, confirmed or already open), area, address, council vote date and the source link. Never states an opening date.

query.description: Name, area or kind, e.g. "sushi", "SanTan Village", "brewery".

status.description: Default coming_soon (filed or confirmed, not open yet).
